lines.text: [excited] Omega! Three new clients want iPhone apps. Same week.
[flatly] And your plan?
[proudly] Copy the last app. Change the logo.
[dry] A church, a dentist and a bakery. [smug] One app.
[defensive] People like sermons.
[sighs] Okay. [warmly] The playbook behind our twenty-four apps. It's free. Watch.
Step one. Every app starts from one shell. Zero third-party packages.
[hopeful] Zero? Not even one little package?
[dry] Nothing to update. Nothing to audit. [smug] Nothing for you to break.
Step two. One design file per client. Edit it, and the whole app changes.
[eager] So I make everything purple?
[deadpan] Each client gets a named look. Harvest. Velour. [dry] Not purple.
Step three. It pulls what they already post. Videos. Calendars. No server.
[excited] Okay. Ship all three tonight. Skip the iPad testing.
[firmly] No. One stretched photo can cover the buttons on iPad. [dry] Review taps everything.
[sheepish] Has that ever happened to us?
[dry] Once. [firmly] Now every photo goes through one wrapper.
[excited] Omega! The bakery loves their new app!
[smug] Ten points per dollar. Four tiers. [dry] Built for a bakery.
[quietly] I added a purple mode.
[flatly] Delete it.
Comment APPS, and I'll send you the repo.
